query:
UPDATE twitch_partners
            SET twitch_login = $1,
                require_discord_link = $2,
                last_description = $3,
                last_link_ok = $4,
                added_by = $5,
                last_link_checked_at = $6,
                next_link_check_at = $7,
                manual_partner_opt_out = $8,
                raid_bot_enabled = $9,
                silent_ban = $10,
                silent_raid = $11,
                live_ping_role_id = $12,
                live_ping_enabled = $13,
                partnered_at = $14,
                admin_archived_at = NULL,
                departnered_at = NULL,
                technical_pause_reason = NULL,
                status = 'active'
            WHERE id = $15
